mapper.update: UPDATE `goal` SET goal_name = #{goalName}, target_amount = #{targetAmount}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, isa_rate = #{isaRate}, deposit_rate = #{depositRate}, start_amount = #{startAmount}, goal_rate = #{goalRate} WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND member_id = #{memberId} /*goal.getGoaldID*/
mapper.select: SELECT goal_id, member_id, goal_name, target_amount, start_date, end_date, deposit_rate, isa_rate, start_amount, goal_rate FROM `goal` WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT goal_id, member_id, goal_name, target_amount, start_date, end_date, deposit_rate, isa_rate, start_amount, goal_rate FROM `goal` WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY goal_id DESC

SELECT mp.member_product_id AS memberProductId, mp.item_name AS itemName, mp.present_amount AS presentAmount, mp.quantity AS quantity, 1 AS checked FROM action a JOIN member_product mp ON mp.member_product_id = a.member_product_id WHERE a.goal_id = #{goalId} AND mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.account_type = 'ISA' AND (a.is_deleted IS NULL OR a.is_deleted = false) ORDER BY mp.member_product_id DESC

select acc.account_id as member_product_id, acc.account_number, acc.account_name, acc.account_balance as present_amount, 1 as checked, COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0) as allocated_amount, (acc.account_balance - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) as remaining_amount FROM account acc -- 각 계좌별로 현재 할당된 총액을 계산하는 서브쿼리 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.account_id, SUM(a.amount) as total_allocated FROM action a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.account_type = 'Deposit' GROUP BY a.account_id ) allocated_sum ON acc.account_id = allocated_sum.account_id INNER JOIN action a ON acc.account_id = a.account_id WHERE acc.member_id = #{memberId} AND acc.is_deleted = false AND a.goal_id = #{goalId} AND a.is_deleted = false ORDER BY acc.account_id DESC
mapper.delete: delete from `goal` where goal_id = #{goalId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.bank_code AS bankCode, a.account_balance AS accountBalance, act.account_allocated_rate AS allocatedRate FROM action act JOIN account a ON act.account_id = a.account_id WHERE act.goal_id = #{goalId} AND act.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_deleted = 0
